description: Patient name and admission/discharge dates are not specified in the discharge summary and missing in the history record.
evidence_in_history: Patient Demographics section states 'Name: Not Provided'; no admission or discharge dates recorded.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary states 'Admission Date: Not specified' and 'Discharge Date: Not specified'; patient name is not mentioned.
suggested_correction: Include patient full name and specify admission and discharge dates in the discharge summary and document patient identifying information in the medical record for completeness.

description: Discrepancy in sumatriptan dosing between medication list and home medications in discharge summary.
evidence_in_history: Medication list shows sumatriptan 50 mg po as needed, max 100 mg/day; office visit notes indicate dose increased to max 200 mg/day.
evidence_in_summary: Home medications mention sumatriptan 50 mg po as needed (max 100 mg/day) adjusted during care, but discharge medications correctly list 100 mg po max 200 mg daily; medication list in history not updated to reflect the increased dosing.
suggested_correction: Update the current medication list in the history to reflect the increased sumatriptan dose of 100 mg as needed, max 200 mg/day consistent with discharge orders.

description: No documentation of counseling or monitoring plan for lithium side effects and renal function despite regular lithium use.
evidence_in_history: Lithium levels are monitored but no explicit mention of monitoring renal function or patient counseling on lithium side effects in SOAP notes or plan.
evidence_in_summary: No mention of renal function monitoring or lithium side effect counseling in hospital course or follow-up plans.
suggested_correction: Add specific instructions and documentation regarding lithium side effect education, regular renal function monitoring (e.g., CMP), and mood symptom review as part of follow-up.

description: Vitamin B12 lab value documented only once in history with no ongoing monitoring plan referenced.
evidence_in_history: Vitamin B12 level measured once on 2024-04-10 (950 pg/mL) but no follow-up test planned or referenced explicitly.
evidence_in_summary: Vitamin B12 therapy noted as monthly IM injection but no lab monitoring or plans mentioned in discharge summary.
suggested_correction: Document ongoing Vitamin B12 level monitoring schedule or justification for discontinuing testing if stable to ensure completeness.

description: Dietary counseling was noted in office visit but is only briefly mentioned in discharge summary without specific dietary recommendations.
evidence_in_history: Visit 2 plan includes 'Counsel patient on diet rich in iron'.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge follow-up mentions 'Reinforce iron-rich diet' but lacks more detailed dietary advice or materials.
suggested_correction: Provide and document specific dietary instructions or referrals (e.g., to dietitian) to better support anemia management.
